name: barber-booking-backend
description: Backend API for barber shop appointment booking system

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd src-front/user && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../barber && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev:user: node scripts/kill-port.js 3001 && cd src-front/user && npm run dev
scripts.dev:barber: node scripts/kill-port.js 3002 && cd src-front/barber && npm run dev
scripts.dev:admin: node scripts/kill-port.js 3003 && cd src-front/admin && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:barber" "npm run dev:admin" --names "USER,BARBER,ADMIN" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan,yellow"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:barber" "npm run dev:admin" --names "BACKEND,USER,BARBER,ADMIN" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,cyan,yellow"

author: Soheil saffari
